How it Works for Home Repair in Atlanta

To get started, you can browse the 8 trades offered by Build Heritage, including painting, drywall, flooring, and roofing. You can also check the service areas to see if your location is covered. The cost guide provides ranges for common services, such as full roof replacement ($9,000-$20,000) and whole-home interior repaint ($3,000-$8,000). You'll also want to consider holding back 10-15% on top of a quote for hidden issues.
